fixtures.title: w crosses keyword, punctuation, and whitespace words
fixtures.purpose: Capture small-word class changes across punctuation runs, a tab, and the final word.

fixtures.title: Counts compose with forward word and WORD motions
fixtures.purpose: Capture counted w, W, e, and E on text whose keyword and punctuation boundaries differ.

fixtures.title: Counts compose with reverse word and WORD motions
fixtures.purpose: Capture counted b, B, ge, and gE from a later word across mixed keyword and punctuation classes.

fixtures.title: Empty logical lines count as words between nonblank lines
fixtures.purpose: Capture forward and reverse word steps over consecutive empty lines and surrounding whitespace.

fixtures.title: Punctuation-only lines remain traversable small words and WORDs
fixtures.purpose: Capture punctuation-only lines beside an empty paragraph and ordinary keyword text.

fixtures.title: Unicode keyword and grapheme boundaries match the pinned Vim word classes
fixtures.purpose: Capture Latin-1 and Unicode-letter keywords, a combining sequence, and an emoji class transition.

fixtures.title: The pinned @ class treats a Unicode letter as keyword
fixtures.purpose: Disambiguate Neovim's @ class for letters above the 192-255 range using an adjacent punctuation boundary.

fixtures.title: The pinned @ class treatment of supplementary numerals is observed
fixtures.purpose: Determine whether a supplementary Unicode number shares the @ class or the punctuation class in word motions.

fixtures.title: The pinned @ class treatment of emoji is observed
fixtures.purpose: Determine whether an emoji shares the @ class or the punctuation class in word motions.

fixtures.title: The pinned @ class relationship between emoji and Unicode letters is observed
fixtures.purpose: Determine whether emoji and letters above 255 form one small word or adjacent classes.

fixtures.title: Default iskeyword separates a hyphen from keyword text
fixtures.purpose: Pin the default iskeyword classification used by word motions.

fixtures.title: Custom iskeyword immediately groups hyphenated text
